name: sgs/choice-flow-question
title: SGS Choice Flow — Question
description: A plain multiple-choice question step. Each option can route to a specific next step, or fall through to the next step in flow order.

question.label: Question text
question._note: v1 (Spec 43 Phase 2): plain-question step only, no colour/typography attrMap yet — kept minimal per FR-43-1's plain-question scope. Element declared for structural documentation; no styling attrs exist on this block to map.

options.label: Options list
options._note: v1: no per-option colour/layout attrs yet — plain list, styled by the block's own stylesheet only.

eyebrow.description: FR-43-24: replaces the 'Question N of M' line above this question, e.g. 'Last bit, and it can wait'. A question with its own eyebrow is left out of the count.

pricePrefix.description: FR-43-17: how option prices read: 'plus' gives '+£30.00', 'from' gives 'from £59.00' (a starting price later choices add to).

summaryLabel.description: FR-43-19: the stage line's label for this unpriced question's answer, e.g. 'Prescription'. Empty uses the step's label.

intro.description: FR-43-24 (v1.8.0): an optional short paragraph shown under the question title, in both layouts — capped to about 56 characters wide in the showcase layout (style.css's own max-width). Empty string = no intro paragraph.

layout.description: User-reported gap (2026-09-15): the AthleanX/Invisalign/lens-flow references show several steps with options stacked VERTICALLY, styled differently to a grid step (smaller side-by-side thumbnail rather than a full-width image banner) — 'grid' keeps the existing 1-col-mobile/2-col-desktop card grid; 'list' forces a single-column stacked row layout at every breakpoint, letting an operator vary this per step/question rather than one fixed layout for the whole flow.

priceGroup.description: FR-43-17 (v1.4.0): names one group in the site-wide add-on price list (WooCommerce > Add-on prices). When set, this question is a priced add-on step — each option's `value` is expected to be one of that group's option keys, and its price is read from the list at render time, never typed into the block. Empty string = plain question, no pricing.

productAttribute.description: Spec 43 Phase 3/4 (FR-43-10/10a): a `pa_*` taxonomy on the flow's own product. When set, this step is a product-option step — its options are generated from the product's attribute terms at render time (not typed), and it can't be combined with `priceGroup` (the editor clears `priceGroup` when this is chosen). Empty string = not a product-option step.

questionFontWeight.description: D7 (2026-09-26 plan, Bean's review): the step heading's font-weight. Defaults to 700 (bold) — titles read too weak at the browser's UA default. Emitted as a class per weight (never inline style — Spec 32), see style.css's `__title--w{weight}` rules.

nextStepId.description: Empty string = advance to the next step in flow order (default, FR-43-2). '__terminal__' = jump to the reachable result step. Any other value = the 0-based DOM-order position of a sibling sgs/form-step within the same sgs/choice-flow, resolved at editor-time by the step picker (not a clientId — clientId is editor-only and unresolvable by render.php/the runtime store, see choice-flow-question/edit.js and choice-flow/view.js).

tags.description: FR-43-12: tags this option contributes to the path's accumulated tag set when chosen, for matching against a sgs/choice-flow-result's own matchTags. Empty when the flow only ever has one result (the common case).

image.description: FR-43-15 (v1.3.0): optional per-option media attachment, shape matches sgs/media's own imageId/imageUrl/imageAlt attribute trio (nested here since this is one entry in a repeater, not a scalar block attribute). Renders in the option card's 16:9 preview zone. Optional — an option with no image (or an empty object) renders exactly as before, a plain text card.

helpText.description: FR-43-16 (v1.3.0): optional per-option explanatory copy, revealed by a floating '?' toggle overlaid on the option card. Empty string = no toggle button renders at all (not a disabled one).

addToBagNow.description: FR-43-20 (v1.4.0): choosing this option adds the page's product with NO add-ons and ends the flow (the draft's 'No prescription — keep the lenses they come with'). Clears any add-on answers already accumulated on this path; the operator still routes it to a result step via `nextStepId` (usually the add-to-bag terminal) — this flag only guarantees the add-on list is empty when it gets there.

isDefault.description: Spec 43 Phase 3/4 §1/§5: pre-selects this option on load and records it as the answer, without auto-advancing. Rendering this pre-selection (Wave 2, question view.js) is not built here — only the stored flag.

badge.description: Spec 43 Phase 3/4 §1/§5: short pill label (up to 20 characters) rendered on the option card, e.g. 'Popular'. Empty string = no badge. Rendering (Wave 2) is not built here — only the stored value.

description.description: Spec 43 Phase 3/4 §1/§5: one line of explanatory copy (up to 140 characters) rendered under the option's label. Empty string = no description line. Rendering (Wave 2) is not built here — only the stored value.
